🐝 Pollination & Plant Reproduction

g.text: Seed → Germination → Seedling → Mature Plant → Flower → Pollination → Fertilization → Seed
Key facts to help you match the labels:
— Green leaf-like structure protecting the bud
— Base where all flower parts attach
Look at the arrows on the diagram to see where each part is located.
→ Green leaf-like parts at the base of petals
→ Orange/yellow oval at top of filament
→ Thin green stalk holding the anther
→ Narrow tube between stigma and ovary
→ Sticky purple top catching pollen grains
→ Green base where all parts connect to stem
Compare your placements with the answer key above.

This will clear all your label placements

In a real application, labels would return to the word bank.
